caption: A straw stands in a glass holding a layer of oil floating on water, and it looks bent twice, once at the oil's surface and again at the boundary between oil and water.

sa.check: A straw stands in a glass holding oil and water.
It looks bent at the oil's surface.
It looks bent again at the boundary between oil and water.
The oil floats as a layer on top of the water.

pc.expect: The straw itself is straight; both kinks are appearances that vanish out of the liquid.
pc.fail: The straw is physically bent when out; or a kink stays at a fixed point on the straw as it is raised; or the straw flexes.

pc.expect: Both kinks sit exactly at the two liquid surfaces.
pc.fail: A kink is away from a surface; or there is only one kink with two plain boundaries; or the straw looks straight through both layers.

pc.expect: The oil floats on the water with a level boundary.
pc.fail: The oil is below the water; or the layers mix; or the boundary tilts and holds.

pc.expect: The straw moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: It rises by itself; or slides; or jumps.
The straw duplicates; or the glass vanishes; or the straw passes through the glass.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The straw and the glass stay the same.
pc.fail: The straw changes colour; or the glass changes shape; or the table changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
